description: Find contractors near a US ZIP code for a job described in plain English (e.g. "water stain on my ceiling", "replace old carpet with hardwood"). Returns ranked local pros with ratings, distance, license verification and escrow_enabled (whether RateDeed can send them a quote request). Read-only.

request.description: What the homeowner needs done, in their own words.

trade.description: Optional: restrict to one trade if already known.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code of the property.

name: search_contractors
title: Find local contractors
